I sat down with Reid, who scaled from zero to $150,000 by building an AI fashion app, without writing a single line of code. This interview breaks down everything from app development strategy to how he nailed the business model. Whether you're into mobile app development or just looking for new business ideas, this video is packed with insights.

If you're wondering how to make an app, Reid’s story will show you what’s possible using no-code tools. We dive into the full app development roadmap, from idea to execution. Perfect for anyone curious about software development, how to create an app, or even just exploring a potential side hustle.

I also cover the mindset shift needed for success in programming, even if you’re just starting. If you're a software developer or looking to become one, this will give you a real-world example of how to build a product and turn it into a business.

Get inspired by app ideas that actually work, learn how to validate them, and see what goes into launching and growing a real business from scratch. This is perfect for full stack development fans, tech enthusiasts, or anyone looking to explore best business ideas in the modern world.
